True def transform(grid):
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 5 for v in row))
    colors = (2, 4)
    growth = {}
    for color in colors:
        above = sum(cell == color for row in grid[:divider] for cell in row)
        below = sum(cell == color for row in grid[divider + 1:] for cell in row)
        growth[color] = below - above
    chosen = 2 if growth[2] >= growth[4] else 4
    return [[chosen, chosen], [chosen, chosen]]
